limitations: The first current-quarter 2025 column is used; the adjacent 2024 and prior-quarter comparison/percentage columns and year-to-date figures are not substitutes. The GAAP consolidated, adjusted operating and AWM segment measures are different reporting bases.

GAAP net income declined USD 148 million while company-defined adjusted operating earnings rose USD 65 million. AWM total client assets are a point-in-time stock and total client flows are quarter flows of a related but different-scope metric. The selected total-client-asset increase cannot be attributed solely to client flows.

Wrap assets have a directly reported bridge: Q2 572,771 + 5,378 + 37,040 = 615,189 and Q3 615,189 + 4,769 + 30,344 = 650,302 USD million. The market-appreciation-and-other line is not pure investment return. Advisory wrap assets are a fee-relevant subset of total wrap assets.
The selected rows do not audit all insurance accounting effects, non-GAAP adjustment components, segment consolidation, client retention, or the complete AWM asset bridge.
